_note: Publisher settings (publish/run.mjs). Tier A = official facts written by code (events, status, dates). A run that would change more tracked entries than max_entries_changed_per_run is treated as an anomaly: nothing is written. auto_publish switches stay off until the field scores at the bar on the accuracy test set (phase 4).

eval_bar._note: Set by the owner. A field may auto-publish only when the latest test-set report (eval/run.mjs) for the production model meets all three: share of in-scope test items whose field passes, published fields with an unsupported quote or number, and scope agreement.
